Welcome to DCK

Established in 2008, DCK Construction is a trusted Tier 1 multi-trade building contractor with a strong reputation for quality and reliability.

Our clients

Our clients are the driving force behind everything we do. We are committed to exceeding expectations and delivering premium-quality, distinctive spaces that reflect their vision and lifestyle.

Our mission

Our mission is simple — to turn your ideas into reality. From concept to completion, we focus on understanding your needs, translating them into practical solutions, and building with precision and care.

Our vision

We envision creating spaces that inspire, bring people together, and remain in perfect harmony with their surroundings — now and for generations to come

CONSTRUCTION & REFURBISHMENT SERVICES

Crafting Strong Foundations for the Future

At DCK, we offer a complete range of professional construction services, guiding your project from initial concept to final completion with precision and care.

See More About Us

Refurbishment / General Build

We have vast experience of delivering high-quality construction projects in several specialist sectors. Key to our success is building strong client partnerships and our ability to work quickly, safely and efficiently in challenging environments, including working in social housing, schools, hospitals and other public buildings, whilst they are occupied and fully operational.
find out more

Fire Safety Works

DCK delivers comprehensive fire safety solutions, including fire door installations, compartmentation works, and fire-stopping measures. Our expert team ensures compliance with the latest regulations, enhancing the safety and protection of residential and commercial properties.
find out more

Aids and Adaptations

We provide specialist mobility adaptations, including Level Access Showers, disabled access ramps, and lifting solutions. Working with a trusted supply chain, we install stairlifts, hoists, platform lifts, shower stretchers, and door entry systems—ensuring safe, accessible, and comfortable living spaces for residents.
find out more

Roofing Works

We deliver specialist roofing works, including full roof replacements, structural repairs, and weatherproofing solutions. Working with trusted suppliers, we install pitched and flat roof systems, upgrade insulation, repair leaks, and renew fascias, soffits, and guttering—ensuring safe, durable, and long-lasting protection for every property.
find out more

Loft / Extension

We specialise in creating additional living space through expertly designed loft conversions and house extensions. Whether you’re looking to add a new bedroom, home office, or open-plan living area, our team manages every aspect — from structural design to final finishes — ensuring your project is completed safely, on time, and to the highest standard.
find out more

Disrepairs / Responsive

We provide a comprehensive Disrepair and Responsive Maintenance Service designed to resolve property issues quickly, efficiently, and to the highest standard. We work with local authorities, housing associations, and private clients to maintain safe, habitable, and compliant homes and buildings.
find out more

Our Partners

Testimonials

DCK Construction has provided exceptional support on our aids and adaptations programme, delivering high-quality accessibility improvements for our residents. Their team demonstrates great sensitivity when working in occupied homes, ensuring comfort, dignity and clear communication throughout. DCK’s workmanship, reliability, and respectful approach make them a trusted partner for Harrow.

London Borough of Harrow

DCK Construction has consistently completed void refurbishments to a high standard, enabling us to re-let properties quickly and efficiently. Their proactive project management, quality finishes, and commitment to maintaining programme deadlines have been invaluable. DCK continues to be a dependable partner in supporting Southwark’s housing objectives.

London Borough of Southwark

DCK Construction has shown exceptional performance across our voids programme, delivering quality refurbishments while maintaining strong communication with our teams. They work efficiently, safely and with clear attention to detail, helping us return homes to residents in excellent condition. DCK’s professionalism and reliability make them a key contractor for Haringey Council.

London Borough of Haringey

DCK Construction has demonstrated strong expertise in delivering compliant fire safety works across Camden properties. Their team works to the highest safety standards, with thorough documentation, clear coordination and high-quality workmanship. DCK’s commitment to resident safety, regulatory compliance and professional delivery makes them a trusted partner for Camden.

London Borough of Camden
